# First Face Transform run

Copy this into Cursor Agent after installing and configuring the plugin. No key is included.

> Use the face MCP tool face_detect_keypoints for one face analysis request. I checked the current Ace Data Cloud price and balance. Set mode 1. Set image_url to https://platform2.cdn.acedata.cloud/seedream/00355681-7e81-49a4-a8fc-d2165fe1e9fd.jpg. Run once, inspect the returned result or error, and do not repeat the call automatically.
